chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn 'Ali, from Mus'ab ibn Sallam al-Tamimi, from Sa'd ibn Tarif, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever gives the adhan for ten years, seeking reward, Allah forgives him to the extent of his sight and his voice in the heaven. Every moist and dry thing that hears him affirms him, and he has a share from everyone who prays with him in his mosque, and he has a good deed from everyone who prays by his voice.

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan, meaning he called people to salat (prayer)
key_terms.رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ: every moist and dry thing, expressing comprehensive witness to the call
key_terms.عَشْرَ سِنِينَ: ten years, indicating long-term constancy in worship

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving the adhan regularly for the sake of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages persistence in giving the adhan with sincerity and seeking divine reward. It describes immense forgiveness and ongoing reward for the mu'adhdhin through those who hear the call and come to prayer.
